adjudication.rationale: The finding is accurate. Looking at embed_controller.rb lines 8-16, when topic_id is nil (no existing embed), the code immediately enqueues a job via `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` before any throttling occurs. The throttling logic is in TopicRetriever (lib/topic_retriever.rb lines 22-31) which only runs AFTER the job is dequeued by Sidekiq workers. The ensure_embeddable method only checks that embeddable_host is set and referer matches, but Referer headers can be spoofed. This means attackers can flood the Sidekiq queue with jobs by sending requests with different embed_urls and spoofed Referer headers matching the embeddable_host.
